claims.quote: The longer stereocilia that project from the outer hair cells actually attach to the tectorial membrane.

source.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.quote: The organs of Corti contain hair cells, which are named for the hair-like stereocilia extending from the cell’s apical surfaces

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: stereocilia array graded in height from tallest to shortest
claims.quote: The stereocilia are an array of microvilli-like structures arranged from tallest to shortest.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.quote: Protein fibers tether adjacent hairs together within each array, such that the array will bend in response to movements of the basilar membrane.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: About 12,000 outer hair cells, set in three or four rows, work to fine-tune incoming sound waves.
claims.quote: The outer hair cells are arranged in three or four rows. They number approximately 12,000, and they function to fine tune incoming sound waves.

source.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Signals sent back from the brain make outer hair cells change length, which sharpens or dampens the hair cells' response to certain frequencies.
claims.quote: The brain can send signals back to the cochlea, resulting in a change of length in the outer hair cells, sharpening or dampening the hair cells’ response to certain frequencies.

source.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Outer hair cells are motile, and this movement may actively help tune the cochlea's sensitivity and frequency selectivity.
claims.quote: The motile properties of the outer hair cells may contribute actively to tuning the sensitivity and frequency selectivity of the cochlea.

claims.value: The outer hair cell is a mechanoreceptor of the organ of Corti; in mammals these cells form three rows lying farther from the modiolus than the single row of inner hair cells.
claims.quote: A mechanoreceptor in the organ of Corti. In mammals the outer hair cells are arranged in three rows which are further from the modiolus than the single row of inner hair cells.

claims.value: Bending the stereocilia toward the tallest member of the array puts tension on the protein tethers, which opens ion channels in the hair cell membrane.
claims.quote: When the stereocilia bend toward the tallest member of their array, tension in the protein tethers opens ion channels in the hair cell membrane.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: When its hairs bend, the hair cell releases an excitatory neurotransmitter at a synapse with a sensory neuron, which then carries action potentials to the central nervous system.
claims.quote: When the hairs bend, they release an excitatory neurotransmitter at a synapse with a sensory neuron, which then conducts action potentials to the central nervous system.

source.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Outer hair cells are wired to only 10 percent of the afferent neurons, and each of those afferent neurons innervates many hair cells.
claims.quote: Outer hair cells connect to only 10 percent of the afferent neurons, and each afferent neuron innervates many hair cells.

source.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

claims.value: Each hair cell along the cochlear duct is sensitive to a particular frequency, so together the hair cells let the cochlea separate sounds by frequency.
claims.quote: The hair cells along the length of the cochlear duct, which are each sensitive to a particular frequency, allow the cochlea to separate auditory stimuli by frequency, just as a prism separates visible light into its component colors.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

tier1.text: A mechanoreceptor in the organ of Corti. In mammals the outer hair cells are arranged in three rows which are further from the modiolus than the single row of inner hair cells. The motile properties of the outer hair cells may contribute actively to tuning the sensitivity and frequency selectivity of the cochlea.
